user_story: As a registered user, I want to sign in securely, so that I can access my account while repeated attacks are blocked.
acceptance_criteria:
AC1: Given 5 consecutive failed attempts, when another sign-in is attempted, then the account is locked for 15 minutes.
AC2: Given the same request to sign in securely was already processed, when it is submitted again, then no duplicate result is created and the existing outcome is shown.
AC3: Given the user has successfully completed the request to sign in securely, when the result is opened again, then the confirmed outcome remains visible without creating another record.
AC4: Given an active account, when valid email and password are submitted, then the dashboard is displayed.
